decisions.why: A web page is the fastest thing you can share as a link. The phone app reuses the same code later.
Bluesky login works today and brings their followers. Our own accounts come when we run our own server.

decisions.q: Where do photos live at first?
decisions.why: In the person's own Bluesky storage costs us $0 and they can leave with it. Our storage (R2) adds speed later.
Contributors need it public. A rename later keeps old links working.
Every creator. AI copies video, music, designs and objects now.

decisions.q: Where do we watch for copies first?
decisions.why: Where art theft is loudest today.

decisions.q: Who owns it at the start?
decisions.why: A nonprofit takes months to form. Start under the LLC, move to a nonprofit host at beta.

items.name: Emera
items.why: Your pick. Greek hemera = day. Soft and modern. But Emera Inc., a big Canadian energy utility (TSX/NYSE: EMA), owns the search results, and the App Store has an "Emera" app.
items.conflictWhy: Emera Inc. energy utility, 2.5M customers; @emera.bsky.social taken

items.name: Arengo
items.why: From your tab. San Marino's assembly of the people, the original agora. No product found with the name.
items.conflictWhy: Closest: Arenago (sports booking, France), Arengu (acquired startup)

items.line: Emera signs its work: the maker's mark that proves who made each post is the brand itself,

mission.mission: Make Emera the open home where humanity's creative work lives: every piece signed by its maker, protected wherever we can see it, shown by rules anyone can read, and paid back to the people who made it.

values.name: Proof over promise
values.line: Every post shows who made it and what was checked, no more than that.

values.name: Real people
values.line: People are marked, bots are named, and a bought following is worth nothing.

values.name: Protected everywhere
values.line: Upload once and we watch for copies and file the takedown for you.

values.name: Open by default
values.line: If a decision moves your work, you can read the rule and the reason.

values.name: You own it
values.line: Your account, your followers and your work are yours, and you can leave with all of them.

values.name: Paid, not harvested
values.line: Emera earns by serving creators, never by selling their attention.

values.name: Welcome first
values.line: A first post and a thousandth post get the same welcome, and nobody has to be against anyone to belong.

asks.title: Choose who owns Emera at the start
asks.why: Grants, donations, the DMCA agent filing and Stripe all need a legal owner. Blocks: DMCA agent name, donations, grant applications, Stripe Connect, hiring

asks.title: Claim @emerasocial on four platforms
asks.why: Free today on TikTok, YouTube and Bluesky; Instagram probably free. Handles get taken. Blocks: Every launch post, press links, the DM campaign, trademark evidence of use

asks.title: Approve emera.social production go-live
asks.why: Production deploy is a stop that needs your yes; staging is up and tested. Blocks: Real sign-in, first creators, the landing page on the real domain, M0 exit test

asks.title: Register the DMCA agent ($6)
asks.why: Without a registered agent we lose safe harbor for user uploads (17 U.S.C. 512(c)(2)). Blocks: Any public user uploads, M1

asks.title: Create Resend account, send from emera.social
asks.why: Sign-in codes are only logged today; production refuses to send. Blocks: Real sign-in, invites by email, M0 exit test

asks.title: Check Canada and EU trademarks
asks.why: US search is clear but Emera Inc. is Canadian and an EU mark may exist (EUTM 014359897). Blocks: Spending on brand and logo, lawyer hour, store listing name

asks.title: Book one lawyer: terms, notices, trademark
asks.why: We send takedowns under penalty of perjury for creators and take their screenshots into a dataset. Blocks: Takedown notice template, report terms, dataset consent, name decision, M1 launch

asks.title: Name 20 illustrators you can DM
asks.why: The first creators come from people who know you; 200 cold DMs convert worse. Blocks: M1 (100 creators), the first Taken-down receipts

asks.title: Post your own profile and 10 works
asks.why: Nobody joins an empty network; yours is the example. Blocks: The public profile demo, press screenshots, invite trust

asks.why: Credits ($10,000 up to $250,000+, sources disagree) cover hosting for a year. Blocks: Free hosting through M3
